    The commercial model

    Base fee + % of incremental revenue.

    • Base fee. Covers the team: strategy lead, media buyer, creative producer, analyst. Senior operators every week, not junior account managers.
    • Incremental, not total. Our share comes only from revenue we create, measured against a cohort baseline.
    • Cap and floor. The variable share is capped (no surprise bills) and floored (fair value even if numbers stall outside our control).
